## Code navigation

With the [Outline view](/docs/editing/getting-started/userinterface.md#outline-view), you can conveniently navigate the members within the current file. [Projects view](/docs/java/java-project.md#projects-view) also provide a great overview of your project. As a Java editor, it also supports Call Hierarchy, Type Hierarchy, Definition Navigation, Search Types in Workspace, etc.
